response.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_spend

assumptions.assumption: The average includes every budget line, with zero cost for lines without expenses.

alternatives.interpretation: Calculate the average using only budget lines that have expenses.
alternatives.sql: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT b.budget_id, COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM budget AS b JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id GROUP BY b.budget_id), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_spend FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_total, COALESCE(SUM(l.expense_count), 0) AS expense_count, AVG(l.total_cost - b.average_spend) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE l.total_cost > b.average_spend
